rows.text: During the Second Prosperity, silver rails crisscrossed the cosmos like a sprawling spider's web, with some routes even overlapping one another. Ships frequently lost their bearings within this tangled network, and some would occasionally wander into uncharted, perilous frontier territory. One Express among the fleet resolved to do something about it, so after months of traversing the web of routes, the Navigator abandoned all attempts to straighten the lanes and instead dedicated themselves to guiding wayfarers. The Nameless dismantled their Trailblaze Power-infused train cars, fashioning countless beacons to be planted among the stars. The remaining frame of the Express was erected at the most congested intersection of all the routes, standing like a lighthouse, or the magnetic pole toward which a thousand compasses point. Travelers could at last find their way, and so it remained, until Akivili fell at the edge of the stars.
